```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import altair as alt
from itables import show
import pandas as pd

from pyosmetrics.plot_theme import load_poppins_font, register_and_enable_poppins_theme

pd.options.mode.chained_assignment = None
pd.options.future.infer_string = True

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
load_poppins_font()
register_and_enable_poppins_theme()

data_path = Path.cwd().parents[0] / "data" / "sprint_data.csv"
sprint_df = pd.read_csv(data_path)
sprint_df["year"] = pd.to_datetime(sprint_df["created"]).dt.year

author_event_summary = sprint_df.groupby(["event", "author"]).size().reset_index(name="count")
unique_authors_by_event = (
    author_event_summary.groupby("event")["author"]
    .nunique()
    .reset_index(name="unique_author_count")
)
total_contributors_by_year = (
    sprint_df.groupby("year")["author"].nunique().reset_index(name="total_contributors")
)

summary_df = sprint_df.groupby(["event", "type"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
summary_df = summary_df.rename(columns={"Issue": "Issue Count", "PullRequest": "PR Count"})
summary_df = summary_df.reset_index()
summary_df["year"] = summary_df["event"].str.extract(r"(\d{2,4})").astype(float).astype("Int64")
summary_df["total"] = summary_df["Issue Count"] + summary_df["PR Count"]
summary_df = summary_df.sort_values(by="year")
annual_counts = summary_df.groupby("year")[["total"]].sum().reset_index()
event_order = summary_df["event"].tolist()

total_sprints = int(sprint_df["event"].nunique())
total_contributions = int(len(sprint_df))
total_participants = int(sprint_df["author"].nunique())
```

## Row {height=auto}

```{python}
#| title: "Total contributions by sprint event"
chart = (
    alt.Chart(summary_df)
    .mark_bar()
    .encode(
        alt.X("event:N", sort=event_order)
            .title("Event")
            .axis(labelAngle=-40, labelOverlap=False, labelLimit=0),
        alt.Y("value:Q")
            .title("Count"),
        alt.Color("type:N")
            .title("Type")
            .scale(range=["#81c0aa", "#735fab"]),
        alt.Tooltip(["event", "Issue Count", "PR Count"]),
    )
    .transform_fold(
        fold=["Issue Count", "PR Count"],
        as_=["type", "value"],
    )
    .properties(
        title="Total Contributions by Event",
        width="container",
        height=420,
    )
    .interactive()
)

chart
```

## Row {height=auto}

```{python}
#| title: "Total contributions by year"
chart = (
    alt.Chart(annual_counts)
    .mark_bar()
    .encode(
        alt.X("year:O")
            .title("Year")
            .axis(labelAngle=0),
        alt.Y("total:Q")
            .title("Total Contributions"),
        alt.Tooltip(["year", "total"]),
    )
    .properties(
        title="Total Sprint Contributions by Year",
        width="container",
        height=360,
    )
    .interactive()
)

chart
```
